events.body:
## Context

In the HTML generated by `generate_repo_list.py`: the search input has only a placeholder; the activity filters are clickable `<div>`s with no role or tabindex; chart bars have `role="button" tabindex="0"` but no keydown handler; the bell link is icon-only; filter/view/sort buttons don't expose `aria-pressed`.

## What to do

1. Add `aria-label` to the search input and bump links.
2. Make the clickable stats `<button>`s and add Enter/Space handling for chart bars.
3. Toggle `aria-pressed` wherever `.active` is toggled.
4. Regenerate the committed `public/index.html`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every control works with Tab/Enter/Space
- [ ] Search has an accessible name
- [ ] Active filter/sort/view exposed via `aria-pressed`
- [ ] `test/escaping.test.mjs` passes

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-owasp-bumper
cd blt-owasp-bumper && python3 -c "import generate_repo_list as g; open('/tmp/b.html','w').write(g.generate_html([], 'OWASP'))"
```

---
Size: **S**. Comment `/assign` to claim this issue; claims with no activity are released after 7 days. Clone from https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT.git and open your pull request there.
